metadata.reward: negative mean completed trip time across ALL vehicles, divided by shortest free-flow time
metadata.baseline: self-critical deterministic rollout of current frozen policy
metadata.optimizer: Adam ascent, learning_rate=0.18, batch=8 by default, gradient norm clip=10
metadata.inference: deterministic argmax; no learning during evaluation
metadata.scope: Milpitas–Sunnyvale corridor; held-out demand seeds, not held-out geography
metadata.coordination: shared parameters + current/future route-commitment board; no message-passing network
